correctness.rationale: For any disjoint edges, mutual EOP compatibility forces both crisscross edges absent; deletion of a matching forces exactly a reciprocal pair. Any packing with such a pair has no third edge; other packings are star subsets. Unique-center counting gives both polynomials and exact facet spectrum. The union of full-star simplices has nerve G_{m,n,t}; attaching one free 1-simplex for each reciprocal pair proves the integral wedge-of-circles homotopy. All graph orders and boundary conditions m,n>=3 and t<=min(m,n) are covered analytically. Independent direct pair enumeration (17 cases), subset DP (33 cases), and mod-2 boundary computations (6 cases) passed; finite tests are corroborative only.

The complete facet classification reveals a sharp two-deletion onset of tiny maximal packings, unbounded maximal-size gaps, and a nonmonotone topological Betti progression even when the scalar maximum barely changes.
